existing_variable_policy: Original football probabilities retain the combined influence of all variables actually used at the time. Archived score means, uncertainty and correlation also enter the penalized candidate. Scoring evidence is retained verbatim. Context-only personnel/matchup inputs and absent historical consensus/money-flow records are not misrepresented as validated numeric inputs.
emh: Market prices are the null benchmark. Existing model and Polymarket variables must improve the same untouched-game probability scores beyond that benchmark.
polymarket_contract_limits: Only exact game/team/kickoff/line matches. Integer spreads are not silently mapped to a different half-point market. Historical trade prices lack archived depth and fees; retrospective evidence is not executable-return evidence.
